front.title: A Multi-Criteria Decision Architecture for Intent-Based Network Slice Selection

abstract.t: This document proposes a two-layer reference architecture -- an Intent Extraction Layer and a pluggable Multi-Criteria Decision Layer -- for translating natural-language operator intent into network slice selection decisions, i.e., ranking among multiple valid candidate configurations. Responding to research challenges identified by the NMRG on intent interpretation and on the misalignment between AI-internal metrics and network-management objectives, the architecture combines explicit handling of unresolved intent, plural independently derived decision methods with explicit agreement reporting, and human validation checkpoints. A motivating scenario from a prototype illustrates the class of failure the design targets. The architecture is proposed as vertical-agnostic; one instance has been prototyped for a Renewable Energy Community deployment and is validated in a companion study.
